title: It's All Downhill From Here
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice swim
200 pull
100 kick

Main Set:
250 Free with fins moderate
5x50 Free build to fast @:55
200 pull moderate
4x50 Free hard @:50
150 choice swim with fins
3x50 Free alternate moderate/hard/fast @:50
100 pull easy
2x50 Free fast @:50

Cool-down:
5x100 (pull, pull, kick, swim, swim) @1:45
coach_notes: Descending main set pattern. Each round removes one 50 while increasing intensity. ~2500 yards.

title: Four Rounds of Fun — Stroke Rotation
text:
Warm-up:
200 Free
150 pull
100 kick
50 choice

Main Set (4 rounds):
Round 1: 3x100 @1:30 (each 100: 25 Fly hard, 75 easy) + 100 easy
Round 2: 3x100 @1:30 (each 100: 25 Back hard, 75 easy) + 100 easy
Round 3: 3x100 @1:30 (each 100: 25 Breast hard, 75 easy) + 100 easy
Round 4: 3x100 @1:30 (each 100: 25 Free hard, 75 easy) + 100 easy

Cool-down:
8x50 @1:00 (alternate kick and swim)
coach_notes: Each round features a different stroke emphasis within 100s. Good variety without heavy stroke volume. ~2500 yards.

title: Milk & Cookies — Ladder 100s
text:
Warm-up:
150 Free
150 Back/Breast/Free
100 kick
100 pull

Main Set:
50 kick + 100 pull + 1x100 Free hard @1:20
50 kick + 100 pull + 2x100 Free hard @1:20
50 kick + 100 pull + 3x100 Free hard @1:20
50 kick + 100 pull + 4x100 Free hard @1:20
100 easy stroke

Cool-down:
4x100 @1:45 (stroke, kick, stroke, Free)
coach_notes: Ascending ladder of hard 100s with kick/pull recovery between sets. Builds volume of quality swimming. ~2600 yards.

title: A Little Bit of Everything
text:
Warm-up:
100 swim
2x50 kick @1:00
100 pull
2x50 stroke @1:00

Main Set:
300 Free
2x150 (Back/Breast/Free) @2:30
300 pull moderate
2x150 IM order @2:30
300 Free
6x50 choice @:50 (alternate stroke/free)

Cool-down:
100 easy choice
2x50 easy back @1:00
coach_notes: Mixed-stroke workout with pull, IM, and stroke variety. Good for general conditioning days. ~3000 yards.

title: Let's See What's Under the Hood — Stroke Count
text:
Warm-up:
200 Free (every 4th 25 double-arm back)
4x50 Back/Free @1:00
100 pull

Main Set (3 rounds):
2x100 Free @1:30 (moderate/build)
2x25 Free (count strokes)
1x150 Free (maintain reduced stroke count)
1x25 Fly fast
1x25 easy
4x50 kick descend @1:00
4x50 Free descend @:50

Cool-down:
100 pull
6x25 (alternate Breast/Free) @:30
coach_notes: Stroke efficiency focus. Count strokes then apply to longer swims. Teaches distance per stroke awareness. ~2700 yards.

title: MySwimPro Structured Workout
text:
Warm-up:
1x200 Free easy
6x50 kick @1:00
4x50 IM @1:00

Main Set:
4x100 pull @1:50
3x100 kick @2:10
8x25 IM order @:40
3x50 Free descend @:50
1x100 Free FAST
3x50 Free descend @:50
1x100 Free FAST

Cool-down:
6x50 easy Back or Free @1:10
source_name: MySwimPro Blog — How to Structure the Perfect Swim Workout
coach_notes: Well-balanced practice with pull, kick, IM, and freestyle speed. Two fast 100s at the end for race simulation. ~2700 yards.

title: Beginner Endurance Builder
text:
Warm-up:
300 easy Free
4x50 Free @1:10
100 drill choice

Pre-set:
8x50 IM order @1:05 (:15 rest)

Main Set:
2 rounds of:
  5x100 Free @1:40 (:20 rest)

Cool-down:
500 easy alternating Back/Free by 100
coach_notes: Beginner-friendly endurance workout. Generous intervals and simple structure. ~2500 yards.

title: Endurance Descending 200s
text:
Warm-up:
400 easy
5x50 drill @1:00 (:10 rest)

Pre-set:
10x50 Free @:55 (vary breathing: 3, 5, 7, 3 pattern by length)

Main Set:
3 rounds of:
  2x200 Free descend @3:00 (:30 rest)
  1:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
300 easy Back
coach_notes: Endurance set with breathing pattern work and descending 200s. Moderate intensity. ~2650 yards.

title: Endurance Threshold 400s
text:
Warm-up:
400 easy
200 IM drill
4x50 Free @:55

Pre-set:
4x100 choice @1:30 (:15 rest)

Main Set:
3x400 Free @5:30 (1:30 rest) with varied pace sections

Post-set:
8x25 underwater Fly kick with fins @:40

Cool-down:
200 easy Back
coach_notes: Threshold 400s with technique bookends. Build aerobic capacity while maintaining form. ~2800 yards.

title: Fun Pyramid Set
text:
Warm-up:
300 easy
4x50 drill @1:00
100 Back

Pre-set:
8x50 IM order @1:00 (:20 rest)

Main Set:
1x25 Free fast
1x50 Free fast
1x75 Free fast
1x100 Free fast
1x150 Free fast
1x200 Free fast
1x150 Free fast
1x100 Free fast
1x75 Free fast
1x50 Free fast
1x25 Free fast
(:05 rest between each)

Cool-down:
400 easy choice
coach_notes: Classic pyramid set going up and down. Short rest forces aerobic pacing on the way up. ~3000 yards.

title: Recovery Day — Low Intensity Mixed
text:
Warm-up:
500 easy Free
200 drill choice

Main Set:
20x100 @2:00 (alternate Back and kick by 100) :30 rest

Cool-down:
300 easy Free
coach_notes: True recovery workout. Low intensity, backstroke and kick focus. No hard efforts. ~3000 yards.

title: Interval Power Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 (alternate swim/kick by 100)

Pre-set:
6x50 drill @1:00
6x50 Free @:50 (:15 rest)

Main Set:
4x200 Free @3:00
8x100 IM @2:30

Post-set:
20x50 Free @:45

Cool-down:
500 easy Free
coach_notes: High-volume interval set mixing Free 200s, IM 100s, and sprint 50s. ~4100 yards.

title: Monster Endurance — Fins and Paddles
text:
Warm-up:
600 easy

Pre-set:
200 drill
400 Free varied breathing

Main Set:
5 rounds of:
  5x100 Free with fins/paddles @1:15

Post-set:
8x50 Back @1:00

Cool-down:
300 easy choice
coach_notes: Equipment-assisted endurance set. Fins and paddles build power while maintaining volume. ~4400 yards.

title: IM Medley Power
text:
Warm-up:
500 easy

Pre-set:
16x50 IM order @1:00

Main Set:
3 rounds of:
  200 Free @3:00
  3x100 IM @1:45
  100 easy
  4x50 IM order @:50
  50 sprint choice
  2:00 rest

Post-set:
8x50 kick with fins @1:00 (:10 rest)

Cool-down:
400 easy Back
coach_notes: IM-heavy workout with sprint finishers in each round. Develops all four strokes under fatigue. ~4650 yards.

title: Sprint Breathing Pattern Set
text:
Warm-up:
400 Free (1:00 rest)
2x100 kick with fins @2:00 (alternate 25 Free kick/25 stroke kick)
2x50 Free @1:00
2x25 choice @:30 (easy/hard)

Main Set:
8x25 IM order @:35 (odds recovery, evens fast)
400 pull (breathe 3-5-7-3 by 25)
8x25 IM @:35
300 Free (breathe 2-4-6-2 by 25)
8x25 Free @:35
200 Free (breathe 3-5-7-3 by 25)
8x25 Free @:35
100 Free (breathe 5-7-5-3 by 25)
8x25 choice @:35

Cool-down:
4x50 choice breathing work @1:00
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Sprint Workouts
coach_notes: Sprint set with progressive breath control. Descending pull/swim distances with consistent 8x25 speed work between. ~2150 yards.

title: Repeat Sprint 50s with Fins
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice

Main Set (10 rounds):
50 Free fast with fins @:10-15 rest
2x25 fast choice with fins @:10-15 rest
50 recovery Back @:20-30 rest
~1:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 breathing patterns @1:00 (:10-15 rest)
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Sprint Workouts
coach_notes: Pure speed work with fins. Short reps, full recovery. Develops neuromuscular speed. ~2100 yards.

title: Kick and Swim Sprint Combo
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice (75 Free/25 stroke)
2x100 IM @2:00

Main Set (3 rounds):
6x50 Free @:50 (:15 rest)
200 kick @4:00
100 recovery Back
1-2:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 breathing patterns @1:00 (:15-20 rest)
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Sprint Workouts
coach_notes: Sprint/kick combination. The kick set between sprint rounds builds leg endurance while providing upper body recovery. ~2600 yards.

title: Descend to Sprint — Pull/Kick/Swim
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice

Main Set (2 rounds):
3x100 Free descend @1:30 (:30 rest)
3x100 pull descend @1:40 (:30 rest)
3x100 kick descend @2:00 (:30 rest)
50 choice recovery
1-2:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 breathing patterns @1:00 (:15-20 rest)
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Sprint Workouts
coach_notes: Descending intensity across swim/pull/kick. Builds to sprint pace in each modality. ~2500 yards.

title: Broken 200 Repeats with Fins
text:
Warm-up:
300 choice (75 Free/25 stroke)
2x100 IM @2:00

Main Set (6 rounds, short fins):
100 Free fast @:15 rest
2x50 Free fast @:10 rest
100 recovery Back
1-2:00 rest between rounds

Cool-down:
6x50 breathing patterns @1:00 (:15-20 rest)
source_name: U.S. Masters Swimming — Best Sprint Workouts
coach_notes: Broken 200s simulate race effort with mid-swim rest. Fins add speed to train neuromuscular patterns. ~2600 yards.

title: 60x100 Marathon Set
text:
Warm-up:
200 easy choice

Main Set:
60x100 Free @1:30 (or @1:45 for slower swimmers)
Optional: use fins or paddles on select rounds

Cool-down:
300 easy Back
coach_notes: Pure distance marathon set. Hold consistent pace for 60 repeats. Mental and physical endurance challenge. ~6500 yards.
